The '''HL Automata-Assisted Welding Laser''' was a model of [[Laser welder/Legends|laser welder]] manufactured by [[Drever Corporation]]. A small tool connected to an external [[Blaster power pack/Legends|blaster power cell]], the welder had a limited range of 3 [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeters]] but was extremely powerful. The HL welding laser was strapped to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and designed to be used for [[Starship/Legends|ship]]-repair.<ref name="CFTD" />
